description: This file defines the RestXmlParser class, which implements REST-XML parsing for AWS services such as S3 and CloudFront. It extends an abstract parser and uses traits and dependencies to parse XML payloads from HTTP responses.

classes.name: RestXmlParser
classes.description: Implements REST-XML parsing for AWS services, uses traits and methods to convert HTTP response streams into structured data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a service description and an optional XML parser.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the payload from the response stream into the result array.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses XML data from a stream and converts it into a structured member using the XML parser.
